result.title: Media Intelligence Platform: Multimodal Detection of Synthetic and Manipulated Content
result.comment: ECCV 2026, Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection (AI4MFDD2026)
result.summary: The rapid progress of generative artificial intelligence has led to a significant increase in manipulated multimedia content, including synthetic faces, forged videos, AI-generated images, fake audio, and locally edited images. Existing detection approaches are typically designed for a single manipulation type, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios involving heterogeneous media sources. In this work, we present the Media Intelligence Platform (MIP), a unified web-based framework for multimodal media forensics integrating specialized modules for fake video detection, face morphing detection, AI-generated image detection, audio deepfake detection, localized image manipulation detection, and text analysis. Its modular architecture enables flexible integration of heterogeneous models and supports future extensions for emerging manipulation techniques. Experimental results on representative benchmark datasets demonstrate reliable detection performance across multiple media modalities while providing a practical and user-friendly interface for forensic investigations. The platform highlights the potential of unified multimodal systems for comprehensive deepfake detection in real-world environments, and is accompanied by a public demonstrator released with this workshop submission to support reproducibility and community evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出一个基于网页的统一多媒体取证平台 MIP，将假视频、人脸形变、AI 生成图像、音频深度伪造、局部图像篡改检测与文本分析等专用模块集成在一起，并在基准数据集上展示多模态检测效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于虚假内容检测与取证系统工程，不涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策，也未触及 VLM 推理机制，缺少可供核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
